title: Readers — the value of pkit::documentation:readers, version 1
description: The data point's companion schema (COR-052 point 5; living-docs DEC-001 point 7): who reads the documentation and what they need. The point is `union`: entries from every filler merge by `id`, a project entry replacing a capability's or the default's whole, and the project may drop one under `remove` with a reason. The default — `user` and `maintainer`, one per mandatory space — always takes part, so a project has readers on day one; a capability that keeps knowledge about the software's users may add its own, under ids of its own. Each page names one of these ids as its `reader` (schemas/page.schema.json), and the capability's validator fails a page whose reader does not resolve. The inert policy is `fail`: a filler that cannot answer leaves the whole point unresolved, and no page's reader is checked until it does. The version rises only on a change that breaks existing fillers.

word.description: A lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and hyphens: the shape a page's `reader` field takes.

id.description: The reader's id, which a page names as its `reader`. Distinct from the ids an analysis capability gives its actors (DEC-001 point 7).

description.description: Who the reader is and what they need from the documentation — what a reader-review reads a page against (DEC-001 point 6).
